params.description: a list of N + 1 elements determining the x-axis spacing of the points, known at compile-time

params.description: an x-axis position to interpolate between the y-values

params.name: yCoords
params.description: N + 1 elements determining the values of the interpolation points Example: find the centre position of a four-point set using an order-3 Lagrange function fitting the equally-spaced points [2, 5, -1, 3]: which outputs ~1.938. Example: output the dashed curve showed on the Wikipedia page (top figure in <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagrange_polynomial>):

references: Sanfilippo and Parker 2021, "Combining zeroth and first‐order analysis with Lagrange polynomials to reduce artefacts in live concatenative granular processing." Proceedings of the DAFx conference 2021, Vienna, Austria.

symbols.name: frwtable
symbols.summary: Look-up updatable circular table with Nth-order Lagrange interpolation for fractional indexes. The index is wrapped-around and the table is circular indexes ranging from 0 to S, which is the table size in samples.
symbols.usage: frwtable(N, S, init, w_idx, x, r_idx) : _

params.name: N
params.description: Lagrange interpolation order, known at compile-time

params.name: S
params.description: table size in samples, known at compile-time

params.name: init
params.description: the initial table content, known at compile-time

params.name: w_idx
params.description: it should be an INT between 0 and S - 1

params.name: x
params.description: input signal written on the w_idx positions

params.name: r_idx
params.description: fractional index wrapped-around 0 and S

io.raw: frwtable(N, S, init, w_idx, x, r_idx) : _

symbols.name: remap
symbols.summary: Linearly map from an input domain to an output range.

params.name: from2
params.description: the domain's upper bound.

params.name: to1
params.description: the range's lower bound.
